title: 3 weeks making a $1mil mobile game with Opus, Codex and Nano banana
author: Productivity_Master
selftext:
This is my 3 weeks progress, goal is to make an actual commercial mobile game.

I am using primarily Opus 5.5 and Codex astra 6 and Fable 5.1 as consultants or play-testers.

I primarily work from Claude Code, and make it call codex image-gen or nano banana straight from inside the harness.

I stopped using Nano banana recently because it was too expensive, spending $20-50 /day, the only benefit you get is fast output, but image quality was very good with Codex on my Max subscription, so I decided to wait longer but have it for free.

This game is a physics based puzzle like angry birds but in 3D. Goal is to knock down all of the blocks from the platform.  
  
Physics has been a rabbit hole. If you make the game too realistic, the tower falls apart just in seconds, and level finishes, so I had to tweak realism and slow down tilting of blocs away from the platform, so they are harder to kick off.

There's still level balancing and polishing to do, including the monetization and events.

One of the events is almost done, daily goals is basically done, need a couple more events to keep engagement high and achieve good D1/D7/D30 retention.

My goal is to finish content for a week of gameplay and publish it on Google Play Market for a beta test.

Happy to answer all your questions about it ;)
